features.description: Emit an evidence contract on every node and edge build_view_state produces: source_kind (closed enum, v0 populates only crawler-provable kinds), confidence (high|medium|low), evidence_basis (observed|inferred), and a provenance block (source_path + extractor id + resolution method). Derived deterministically from signals already present; no new extractors.
features.acceptance: Every emitted node and edge carries source_kind + confidence + evidence_basis + provenance; resolved intra-repo imports are observed/high while curated-catalog/manifest-derived nodes are declared/medium; a test asserts the fields are present and deterministic across two builds; existing consumers (007 map, .mmd export) keep working.

features.description: Stop silently dropping unresolved references. Unresolved imports/refs (external/stdlib/unresolved-authored) are emitted as edges with evidence_basis=inferred, confidence=low, and an explicit unresolved marker, so missing evidence is visible rather than invisibly absent.
features.acceptance: A fixture with an unresolved import yields a low-confidence inferred edge (not a dropped edge); the edge is flagged unresolved; a test asserts unresolved refs appear in the model and are never marked observed/high.

features.description: Add a top-level extractor-coverage block: which extractors ran, which evidence kinds are covered vs missing/not-applicable for this repo, and an overall coverage + confidence summary. Honest for absent kinds so a repo with no Swift/build/ADR extractor reports limited coverage instead of a confident map.
features.acceptance: The view-state carries a coverage block enumerating extractors run + evidence kinds covered/missing + an overall summary; for the DontPanic repo it reports python/schema/manifest covered and swift/build_config/adr as missing-or-not-applicable; a test asserts absent extractors surface as low/limited, never as covered.

features.description: Split the model into as_built and intent layers and define the as-built<->intent diff taxonomy (schema-only). The intent layer's claim shape is defined but EMPTY in v0 (no ADR ingestion); the diff taxonomy enum is defined with an empty/placeholder diff list. No reconciliation logic beyond the empty shape.
features.acceptance: The view-state exposes as_built (today's nodes/edges) + an intent layer (claim shape defined, empty) + a diff list keyed by a defined taxonomy enum (aligned|drifted|unverified|implemented_undocumented|documented_unimplemented|conflicting_dependency|stale_adr|unknown_confidence), empty in v0; a test asserts the shape exists and is honestly empty (no fabricated diffs/claims).
